description: This source file defines React components and hooks for client-side user access control guards in a Next.js project. It includes a GuardStatus type, an InlineAlert component for UI alerts, and a useClientGuard hook that checks onboarding and quiz completion status using Redux selectors.

methods.name: InlineAlert
methods.description: A React functional component rendering a styled inline alert with title, optional description, and actions.

methods.name: useClientGuard
methods.description: A React hook that determines if the user satisfies onboarding and quiz completion prerequisites. Returns a boolean and an inline alert notice if prerequisites are unmet.
